svg.title: Three-Flow Ultra-Low-Latency Stock Exchange Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of an ultra-low-latency electronic stock exchange showing the critical trading path on a single CPU-pinned bare-metal server with dev-shm mmap event bus, embedded order manager, single-writer sequencer, deterministic single-threaded matching engine with hot standby Raft replication, decoupled non-critical market data publisher with reliable UDP multicast, and compliance reporting flows.
svg.text: Three-Flow Ultra-Low-Latency Stock Exchange Architecture (Tick-to-Trade < 50 μs)
Single Bare-Metal Core-Pinned Server · /dev/shm mmap Event Bus · Embedded Risk & Wallet · Deterministic Matching · Muted Hot Standby
CRITICAL TRADING PATH (Primary Engine: isolcpus Core-Pinned · Zero-GC Zero-Lock · /dev/shm mmap Ring)
Zero kernel syscalls · 64-byte alignas cache-line padding (no false sharing) · Monotonic seq_num sequence cursors
Hot-Standby Replication Node (Raft Quorum / Reliable UDP / Aeron Cluster · RPO = 0, RTO < 10 ms)
Hot cache ready for instant cut
Lock-free ring buffer consumes execution stream
Decoupled from matching thread to avoid core jitter
Single physical wire frame delivers ticks simultaneously
Equalized physical fiber spools inside colocation cages
Gap recovery: NACK sequence requests + snapshot TCP
EOD rollover flushes to cold compressed Parquet lakehouse
Public edge CDN caches /data/recent (1s TTL) against DDoS
Asynchronous batch reader from /dev/shm event stream
Extracts client_id, execution_id, fill price & volume
Guarantees zero backpressure on critical matching core
SEC Rule 613 CAT & MiFID II RTS 25 PTP audit trail
End-of-day broker margin settlement & tax statements
Ultra-Low-Latency Budget & Production Design Invariants (Tick-to-Trade Budget <= 50 μs)
One core per symbol shard eliminates locks,
mutexes, and OS context switch jitter (15μs).
Solarflare Onload / DPDK bypasses Linux stack.
SBE fixed-offset binary structs decode with
zero string parsing and zero heap allocation.
Aeron Cluster in-memory Raft replicates monotonic
seq_num log over 100GbE RDMA/UDP in same rack.
Fences stale primary epochs without disk fsync.
consume async via ring buffers. Zero blocking,
zero database locks on critical order execution.
